usedFor: beatandraise watches SEC filings, and LeadConnector receives each “New Filing” as a contact through “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Filing” in beatandraise, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: It updates a contact that already exists, so repeated filings never create a duplicate record.

watchOut: “New Filing” runs daily, so contacts reach LeadConnector once a day, not the moment a company files.
